observations: Three photos show the same laptop from slightly different angles, open and resting on a dark fabric surface.
The screen is severely cracked with multiple long fissures across the display, especially concentrated in the center and lower half.
The laptop has a silver/gold-colored palm rest and black keyboard.
The ASUS logo is visible on the lower right of the palm rest in all photos.
Stickers on the palm rest include Intel Core i7, Windows 7, and HDMI, along with a larger ASUS sticker showing 'NVIDIA GeForce' and '15.6' inch screen.
The keyboard appears intact, with no visible missing or damaged keys.
The touchpad is intact and centered below the keyboard.
No ports or hinges are visible in the photos.
The screen is off in all photos, so no display functionality can be assessed.

claims.evidence: ASUS logo and model sticker visible on palm rest in all photos.
Intel Core i7 sticker visible on palm rest in all photos.
No internal components or system information visible. Cannot confirm RAM or storage type/size from photos.
NVIDIA GeForce sticker visible on palm rest in all photos, though exact model and VRAM not readable.
Sticker on palm rest in all photos clearly shows '15.6' inch screen.

response.reason: The screen is severely cracked, which is a major defect affecting usability. While the model and some specs are visually confirmed, internal components and functionality are unverified. Without proof of working condition and accurate specs, the item cannot be priced accurately.
